messages.content: On VirusTotal, could you show me the subdomains of domain paypal.com? Set the limit to 25 and use the continuation cursor 'pp_next'. My API key is pp_key123.

We need to call the appropriate endpoint. According to VT docs, there's an endpoint GET /v2/domains/{domain}/sub-domains?limit={}&cursor={} . We have to provide headers Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> or X-Apikey header maybe. But we don't know exact details; but likely it's something like:

GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/sub_domains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next

Headers:
x-apikey: pp_key123

But we cannot actually make HTTP requests from this environment. There's no tool defined for making arbitrary HTTP calls. So we can't fetch data directly. In previous tasks, sometimes they expect us to simulate calling the API via some custom function. However there is only one function available: get_current_weather. That does not help here.

Thus we might respond explaining inability due to lack of network access. Or ask clarifying question about whether they'd like sample output etc. Probably best to explain limitation.
